configuration_map: No geometric configuration exists. All objects (r, s, t, x, y) are straight lines (magnitudes) related only through proportional and commensurability relations. The constructions (third proportional via 6.11, mean proportionals via 6.13) produce proportional relationships but the proof never reasons about their spatial arrangements. Every step operates purely through ratio manipulation, proportion theory, and commensurability definitions.
skip_reason: The proof is purely algebraic/proportional with no geometric configuration claims. It deals entirely with ratios, proportions, and commensurability of magnitudes (Book 10 irrational magnitude theory). No points are placed inside/outside figures, no rays are ordered, no angles are decomposed, and no spatial positions are established or relied upon.
